guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水。數據取自公開資料並經四捨五入，用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain. Figures come from public sources and are rounded for learning comparisons; they are not design values.
facts: ASTM E331 靜態水密試驗在噴水與壓差同時作用下持續 15 分鐘
AAMA 501.1 以直徑 84 in（約 2.1 m）的螺旋槳風機與每小時每平方英尺 5 加侖噴水進行 15 分鐘動態水密試驗
5 gal/ft²·h 噴水量約等於 3.4 L/m²·min
AAMA 501.2 現場噴水以 B25 #6.030 噴嘴在噴嘴處 30 psi（約 207 kPa），每 5 ft 接縫噴 5 分鐘
美國帷幕牆規範常要求 300 Pa（6.24 psf）下空氣洩漏不超過約 0.3 L/s·m²（0.06 cfm/ft²）
AAMA 503 等現場試驗常把水密壓力取實驗室的 2/3、空氣洩漏允許值放寬為 1.5 倍
英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機波及超過 900 棟建築、約 31,000 戶
台北 101 外牆系統公開資料稱可承受約 95 mm 側向地震位移而不損壞
麻省理工學院 Stata 中心 2004 年啟用，2007 年因漏水等問題提起訴訟，2010 年和解
factsEn: ASTM E331 holds spray and static pressure together for 15 minutes
AAMA 501.1 uses an 84 in (about 2.1 m) propeller wind generator and 5 gal/ft²·h spray for a 15-minute dynamic water test
A spray rate of 5 gal/ft²·h equals about 3.4 L/m²·min
AAMA 501.2 field hose testing uses a B25 #6.030 nozzle at 30 psi (about 207 kPa), 5 minutes per 5 ft of joint
US curtain-wall specifications commonly limit air leakage to about 0.3 L/s·m² (0.06 cfm/ft²) at 300 Pa (6.24 psf)
Field tests such as AAMA 503 commonly use 2/3 of the laboratory water pressure and 1.5 times the laboratory air allowance
The British Columbia leaky-condo crisis affected over 900 buildings and about 31,000 housing units
Public information states that Taipei 101's façade system can take about 95 mm of lateral seismic displacement without damage
MIT's Stata Center opened in 2004, was the subject of a 2007 lawsuit over leaks and other defects, and settled in 2010
timeline: 1998　英屬哥倫比亞 Barrett 委員會報告指出過度依賴表面密封牆體，同年通過住宅所有人保護法
2004　麻省理工學院 Stata 中心啟用，台北 101 同年完工
2006　英屬哥倫比亞建築規範對沿海氣候採納雨幕構造要求
2007　麻省理工學院就 Stata 中心漏水與其他缺陷提起訴訟
2010　Stata 中心訴訟和解，多數問題已修復
2015　AAMA 501.2-15 現場噴水試驗版本發布
timelineEn: 1998 — The British Columbia Barrett Commission identifies reliance on face-sealed walls, and the Homeowner Protection Act passes the same year
2004 — MIT's Stata Center opens and Taipei 101 is completed in the same year
2006 — The British Columbia Building Code adopts rainscreen requirements for coastal climates
2007 — MIT files suit over leaks and other defects at the Stata Center
2010 — The Stata Center lawsuit is settled with most issues resolved
2015 — The AAMA 501.2-15 edition of the field hose water test is issued
codes: ASTM E283／E331／E547：實驗室空氣洩漏、靜態與循環靜壓水密試驗
AAMA 501.1／501.2／503：動態水密、現場噴水與現場性能試驗
ASTM E1105 與 E783：已安裝外牆的現場水密與氣密試驗
EN 12153、EN 12155 與 EN 13830：帷幕牆氣密、水密試驗與性能分級
codesEn: ASTM E283 / E331 / E547: laboratory air leakage and static and cyclic static water-penetration tests
AAMA 501.1 / 501.2 / 503: dynamic water, field hose and field performance testing
ASTM E1105 and E783: field water-penetration and air-leakage tests of installed façades
EN 12153, EN 12155 and EN 13830: curtain-wall air permeability and watertightness tests and classification
landmarks: 麻省理工學院 Stata 中心
landmarksEn: Ray and Maria Stata Center, MIT
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：建築外牆氣密水密試驗
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Facade air- and water-tightness testing
guides.concept: 從雨水穿透外牆的驅動力與風壓換算出發，說明壓力等化雨幕、空氣屏障與接縫毛細作用的原理，再把設計風壓轉成 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列試驗的壓力與允收值，處理樣品牆試驗、施工中現場抽驗與 AAMA 501.2 噴水試驗的時程，最後以漏水診斷、事件後複驗與交接紀錄收尾，並以台北 101、麻省理工學院 Stata 中心與英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機說明試驗與設計失誤的代價。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the forces that drive rain through a façade and the conversion of wind pressure, explain pressure-equalised rainscreens, air barriers and capillarity at joints, then turn design pressure into the test pressures and acceptance values of ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, covering mock-up testing, field sampling during installation and the time budget of AAMA 501.2 hose testing, and close with leak diagnosis, post-event re-testing and handover records, using Taipei 101, MIT's Stata Center and the British Columbia leaky-condo crisis to show what testing and design errors cost.
procedure: 雨水要穿過外牆，需要同時具備三個條件：牆面有水、有開口、有把水推過開口的力。驅動力包括重力（水沿向內傾斜的面流入）、雨滴動能、表面張力與毛細作用、氣流帶動，以及最重要的室內外壓差。颱風時迎風面外部壓力高於室內，壓差會把附著在接縫上的水「吸」進牆內，甚至推過排水槽的擋水高度。因此水密設計不能只靠密封膠，而要逐一切斷每一種驅動力，試驗則是在可控壓差下確認這些措施有效。

壓力等化雨幕把外牆分成兩道防線：外側的雨幕擋住大部分雨水，但刻意留有通氣開口；內側的空氣屏障則必須連續且氣密。當外部風壓變化時，空氣經由通氣開口進入兩道防線之間的腔體，使腔體壓力接近外部壓力，雨幕兩側的壓差就很小，水不再被壓差推過外層接縫；真正承受壓差的是乾燥的內側空氣屏障。若空氣屏障漏氣，腔體壓力就無法建立，等化失效。英屬哥倫比亞沿海在 1990 年代大量出現的漏水公寓，調查即指出過度依賴「單層表面密封」的牆體是主因之一。

外牆的空氣洩漏量隨壓差增加而增加，但不是線性：通過細小縫隙的氣流介於層流與紊流之間，可用 Q = C·ΔP^n 描述，n 常介於 0.5（完全紊流的孔口）與 1.0（層流）之間。洩漏量影響的不只是空調能耗，室內潮濕空氣冬季外洩會在牆內結露，夏季濕熱空氣內滲也會造成凝結與發霉。實驗室試驗依 ASTM E283 在指定壓差下量測單位面積洩漏量，美國帷幕牆規範常要求在 300 Pa（6.24 psf）下不超過約 0.3 L/s·m²（0.06 cfm/ft²），但不同規範的試驗壓力不同，比較時必須換算。
外牆漏水最常發生在介面而不是材料本身：上下單元接縫、轉角、帷幕牆與石材或金屬板的交界、穿越外牆的管線與招牌錨栓，以及帷幕牆與屋頂、地坪的收邊。細小縫隙會產生毛細作用，即使沒有壓差也能把水吸進牆內；把縫隙放寬到數毫米以上、設置滴水線與毛細斷開槽，可以切斷這種驅動力。介面因為分屬不同承包商，常在圖面上只畫一條線，現場卻沒有人負責防水的連續性。
實驗室性能樣品牆是量產前最重要的關卡：在密閉試驗艙上安裝實尺寸外牆，依規定順序進行氣密、靜態水密、動態水密、結構與層間位移等試驗，再重複氣密與水密，以確認結構變形後仍保有性能。試驗壓力由設計風壓換算：結構試驗常以設計風壓與其 1.5 倍驗證；水密試驗則取設計風壓的一定比例並設下限。試驗順序很重要，先做結構再做水密，才能反映颱風後的真實狀態。
實驗室證明的是設計與製造，現場試驗證明的是安裝。因為現場的試體邊界、密封條件與量測精度都不如實驗室，AAMA 503 等現場試驗規範通常把水密試驗壓力降為實驗室的三分之二，並把允許的空氣洩漏量放寬為實驗室值的 1.5 倍。現場試驗最有價值的時機是安裝初期：在第一批樓層完成時就測，可在問題擴散到整棟樓之前修正工法；之後再於中期與完工前抽驗，確認品質穩定。
氣密試驗量到的是流過整個試驗艙的空氣，其中包括試體本身的洩漏，也包括試驗艙與試體邊框之間、艙體接縫的「基準洩漏」。正確的程序是先以塑膠膜完全封住試體，在相同壓差下量測基準洩漏，再撕開膜量測總洩漏，兩者相減才是試體洩漏，再除以試體面積得到單位面積洩漏量。溫度、濕度與大氣壓也會影響流量計讀值，須依標準修正到標準狀態。
水密試驗有三種主要形式：ASTM E331 在外側以噴水架均勻噴水，同時在試體兩側維持靜態壓差 15 分鐘；AAMA 501.1 以大型螺旋槳風機產生紊動風與噴水，模擬颱風的動態壓力與風雨，檢查壓力等化系統在脈動下是否有效；AAMA 501.2 則是在現場以手持噴嘴對已安裝的接縫直接噴水，沒有壓差，只檢查接縫與介面的施工品質。三者各有角色，不能互相取代：現場噴水合格不代表系統在壓差下不漏。

使用中的外牆漏水，難處在於水在牆內移動的路徑常與內側出水點相距甚遠。診斷要從資料開始：漏水時的風向、雨量與持續時間，再以分段噴水由下往上隔離可疑接縫，搭配紅外線熱像、含水率計與局部拆檢找出入口。小量長期滲漏比偶發的大量漏水更危險，因為它在牆內持續累積，造成金屬腐蝕、隔熱層失效與發霉。英屬哥倫比亞沿海的漏水公寓危機與麻省理工學院 Stata 中心的漏水訴訟，都顯示外牆水密失敗最後會變成昂貴的修復與法律責任。
外牆的氣密水密性能會因地震層間變位、颱風反覆壓力、密封材老化與後續改裝而改變。台北 101 的外牆系統公開資料指出可承受約 95 mm 的側向地震位移而不損壞，這類設計能力需要以層間位移後再做水密試驗的程序驗證，也提醒管理者在大事件後應檢查接縫與密封是否位移。交接時應建立性能基準：試驗報告、現場抽驗結果、介面清單與漏水紀錄格式，讓日後的複驗能與原始狀態比較。
procedureEn: For rain to pass through a façade, three conditions must coexist: water on the wall, an opening, and a force to move the water through it. The forces are gravity (water running along inward-sloping surfaces), raindrop momentum, surface tension and capillarity, air currents and, most important, the pressure difference between outside and inside. In a typhoon the windward exterior pressure exceeds the interior, and the difference draws water clinging to joints into the wall or even pushes it over the dam of a drainage channel. Watertightness therefore cannot rely on sealant alone but must cut off each force in turn, and testing confirms under controlled pressure that these measures work.

A pressure-equalised rainscreen divides the wall into two lines of defence: an outer rainscreen that stops most rain but deliberately has vents, and an inner air barrier that must be continuous and airtight. As exterior pressure changes, air flows through the vents into the cavity between them, bringing cavity pressure close to the exterior so that the pressure difference across the rainscreen is small and water is no longer pushed through its joints; the dry inner air barrier takes the pressure difference. If the air barrier leaks, cavity pressure cannot build and equalisation fails. Investigations into the leaky condominiums of coastal British Columbia in the 1990s identified reliance on face-sealed walls as a main cause.

Façade air leakage rises with pressure difference but not linearly: flow through small cracks lies between laminar and turbulent and is described by Q = C·ΔP^n, with n usually between 0.5 for a fully turbulent orifice and 1.0 for laminar flow. Leakage affects more than HVAC energy: moist room air escaping in winter condenses inside the wall, and hot humid air infiltrating in summer also causes condensation and mould. Laboratory tests to ASTM E283 measure leakage per unit area at a specified pressure difference, and US curtain-wall specifications commonly require no more than about 0.3 L/s·m² (0.06 cfm/ft²) at 300 Pa (6.24 psf), but test pressures differ between codes, so comparisons need conversion.

Façade leaks occur most often at interfaces rather than in the materials themselves: stack joints, corners, junctions between curtain wall and stone or metal panels, pipes and sign anchors through the wall, and the terminations of the curtain wall at roofs and grade. Fine gaps create capillary action that can draw water inward even without a pressure difference; widening gaps to several millimetres and providing drips and capillary breaks cuts off this force. Because interfaces belong to different contractors, they are often drawn as a single line while on site nobody owns the continuity of the weatherproofing.

The laboratory performance mock-up is the most important gate before production: a full-size façade is mounted on a sealed test chamber and tested in a prescribed sequence for air, static water, dynamic water, structural and racking performance, then air and water again to confirm performance survives structural deformation. Test pressures derive from design pressure: structural tests commonly verify the design pressure and 1.5 times it, while water tests take a fraction of design pressure with a minimum. The sequence matters, since water tests after structural loading reflect the real condition after a typhoon.

The laboratory proves design and manufacture; field tests prove installation. Because specimen boundaries, sealing and measurement precision on site are poorer than in the laboratory, field-test standards such as AAMA 503 usually reduce the water-test pressure to two thirds of the laboratory value and relax the allowable air leakage to 1.5 times the laboratory value. The most valuable time for field testing is early: testing as soon as the first floors are complete lets workmanship be corrected before a problem spreads through the building, followed by sampling at mid-point and before completion to confirm consistent quality.

An air test measures the air flowing through the whole chamber, which includes the specimen's own leakage plus tare leakage between chamber and specimen frame and at chamber joints. The correct procedure first seals the specimen completely with plastic film and measures tare leakage at the same pressure, then removes the film and measures total leakage; the difference is the specimen leakage, which is divided by specimen area to give leakage per unit area. Temperature, humidity and barometric pressure also affect flow-meter readings and must be corrected to standard conditions.

Water tests take three main forms: ASTM E331 sprays the exterior uniformly from a spray rack while holding a static pressure difference across the specimen for 15 minutes; AAMA 501.1 uses a large propeller wind generator with spray to create turbulent wind and rain, simulating the dynamic pressures of a typhoon and checking whether pressure equalisation works under pulsation; AAMA 501.2 sprays installed joints on site with a hand-held nozzle and no pressure difference, checking only the workmanship of joints and interfaces. Each has its role and none replaces another: passing a field hose test does not mean the system stays dry under pressure.

The difficulty with leaks in service is that water often travels far inside the wall from where it enters to where it appears. Diagnosis starts with data on wind direction, rainfall and duration during leaks, then isolates suspect joints by segment-by-segment spraying from the bottom up, with infrared thermography, moisture meters and local opening-up to find the entry point. Small long-term leaks are more dangerous than occasional large ones because they accumulate inside the wall, corroding metal, degrading insulation and causing mould. The leaky-condominium crisis in coastal British Columbia and the leak litigation over MIT's Stata Center both show that façade watertightness failures end in costly repairs and legal liability.

Façade air and water tightness can change with seismic drift, repeated typhoon pressure, sealant ageing and later alterations. Public information on Taipei 101 states that its façade system can take about 95 mm of lateral seismic displacement without damage; such capacity must be proven by a procedure that repeats the water test after racking, and it reminds managers to check joints and seals for displacement after major events. Handover should establish a performance baseline of test reports, field results, the interface register and the leak-log format so that later re-tests can be compared with the original state.
evidence: 外牆設計說明須列出各風壓區的水密試驗壓力與對應的擋水高度，並要求所有水平構件向外洩水；擋水高度與洩水坡度在深化圖審查時逐一核對，由帷幕牆顧問簽認。
外牆圖說要以顏色或線型標示空氣屏障的連續路徑，包括與樓板、屋頂、地坪及相鄰系統的接續；腔體分隔與通氣口位置在深化圖與樣品牆中確認，空氣屏障的任何中斷須經帷幕牆顧問核可處理方式。
規範要同時寫明允收洩漏量、試驗壓力、正負壓方向與面積計算方式，並要求提交多點壓力的洩漏曲線而非單一數字；比較不同標準（ASTM 與 EN 分級）時，由帷幕牆顧問統一換算後再判定。
以介面清單作為合約附件，每一個介面都有唯一負責單位與試驗要求；介面處的覆蓋前檢查設為停止點，由帷幕牆顧問或監造確認噴水試驗合格後才能封閉。
樣品牆試驗合格是量產的停止點；試驗報告要附上所有修改的照片與圖說，並由帷幕牆顧問確認修改已納入量產與安裝程序。量產第一批產品須與試驗品逐項比對。
evidenceEn: The façade design statement should list the water-test pressure and corresponding dam height for each wind zone and require all horizontal members to shed water outward; dam heights and drainage falls are checked one by one at shop-drawing review and signed by the façade consultant.

Façade drawings should trace the continuous air-barrier line in colour or linetype, including its connections to slabs, roof, ground and adjacent systems; cavity compartments and vent positions are confirmed in shop drawings and the mock-up, and any break in the air barrier needs the façade consultant's approved remedy.

The specification must state the allowable leakage, test pressure, positive and negative directions and area basis together, and require a multi-point leakage curve rather than one number; when comparing standards such as ASTM limits and EN classes, the façade consultant converts them on a common basis before judging.

Attach the interface register to the contracts so every interface has one responsible party and a test requirement; make pre-cover inspection at interfaces a hold point, released only after the façade consultant or supervising engineer confirms a passed hose test.

A passed mock-up is the hold point for production; the test report must include photographs and drawings of every modification, with the façade consultant confirming they are incorporated in production and installation procedures, and the first production batch is compared item by item with the tested specimen.
pitfalls: 以低樓層的風壓設計整棟樓的擋水高度，高樓層在颱風中水被推過橫框擋水，沿樓板邊緣流進室內；把窗台做成向內傾斜，重力就把水直接帶進牆內，再好的密封也擋不住。
把在 75 Pa 下合格的窗戶數據直接拿來比較 300 Pa 的帷幕牆規範，誤以為符合要求，完工後冬季樓板邊緣與窗框周邊出現大量結露；只測正壓而未測負壓，背風面的實際洩漏遠大於報告值。
樣品牆只做了典型單元而省略轉角與介面，試驗順利過關，量產後漏水卻集中在轉角與屋頂收邊；或試驗中為了通過而大量補打密封膠，卻沒有回寫到量產圖，現場產品與試驗品並不相同。
試驗艙邊框密封不良，基準洩漏比試體洩漏還大，量測誤差掩蓋了試體的真實表現；或基準洩漏只在單一壓差量測，其他壓差直接套用，造成洩漏曲線失真而誤判合格。
管理單位只在室內出水點補打密封膠，真正的入口在數米外的上方介面，水改道從其他位置流出；牆內長期累積的水使鋼件鏽蝕、隔熱棉失效，等到發現時已需拆除整片外牆修復。
pitfallsEn: Sizing dams for the lower-floor pressure throughout lets typhoon rain at upper floors overtop the transom dams and run along the slab edge indoors; a sill sloping inward lets gravity carry water straight into the wall, which no sealant can stop.

Comparing window data that passed at 75 Pa directly with a curtain-wall specification at 300 Pa wrongly suggests compliance, and after completion heavy winter condensation appears at slab edges and around frames; testing only under positive pressure misses much larger real leakage on leeward faces.

A mock-up limited to typical units, omitting corners and interfaces, passes easily while production leaks concentrate at corners and roof terminations; or sealant is added liberally during testing to pass but never written back into production drawings, so site products differ from the tested specimen.

A poorly sealed chamber frame gives tare leakage larger than the specimen's, so measurement error hides the specimen's real performance; or tare leakage measured at only one pressure is applied to all others, distorting the leakage curve and producing a false pass.

Management seals only where water appears indoors while the real entry is an interface several metres above, so the water reroutes and emerges elsewhere; water accumulating inside the wall for years rusts steel and ruins insulation, and by discovery the remedy requires removing whole areas of cladding.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 單元式帷幕牆安裝
related.transfer: 可遷移「雨水滲透的驅動力與風壓」與「氣密量測、試驗艙修正與結果判讀」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；單元式帷幕牆安裝的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Driving forces of rain penetration and wind pressure" and "Air-leakage measurement, chamber correction and interpretation" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Unitized curtain-wall installation must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以驅動壓差、壓力等化、洩漏特性與實驗室及現場試驗程序，驗證外牆在風雨中不漏氣、不漏水；單元式帷幕牆安裝則以以錨定反力、上下單元接縫變位、豎框勁度與安裝公差控制，讓工廠組裝的單元板塊在高層主結構上可靠就位為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on driving pressure, pressure equalisation, leakage characteristics and laboratory and field procedures that prove a façade keeps out air and rain; Unitized curtain-wall installation centres on anchor reactions, stack-joint movement, mullion stiffness and installation tolerance control that seat factory-built units reliably on a tall structure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「風壓驅動水頭」與「樓板邊緣錨件反力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到單元式帷幕牆安裝，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「性能樣品牆與層間位移試驗」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Wind-driven water head” and “Slab-edge anchor reaction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Unitized curtain-wall installation, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Performance mock-up and racking test", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
history.text: 外牆水密的現代理解來自「雨幕原理」：讓外層通氣、使腔體壓力接近外部，壓差由內側乾燥的空氣屏障承擔。北美在 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列中建立了實驗室與現場試驗方法，歐洲則以 EN 12153、EN 12155 等標準與 EN 13830 分級。1980 至 2000 年代初英屬哥倫比亞沿海大量公寓漏水，1998 年 Barrett 委員會指出過度依賴表面密封的牆體，促成當地規範要求雨幕構造；2004 年啟用的麻省理工學院 Stata 中心在 2007 年因漏水等問題提起訴訟，2010 年和解；同年代完工的台北 101 則公開其外牆可承受約 95 mm 側向位移。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The modern understanding of façade watertightness comes from the rainscreen principle: vent the outer layer so cavity pressure approaches exterior pressure, leaving the pressure difference to a dry inner air barrier. North America established laboratory and field test methods in ASTM E283, E331 and the AAMA 501 series, while Europe uses standards such as EN 12153 and EN 12155 with classification under EN 13830. From the 1980s to the early 2000s large numbers of condominiums in coastal British Columbia leaked; in 1998 the Barrett Commission identified reliance on face-sealed walls, leading local codes to require rainscreen construction. MIT's Stata Center, opened in 2004, became the subject of a 2007 lawsuit over leaks and other problems, settled in 2010, while Taipei 101, completed in the same era, states publicly that its façade can take about 95 mm of lateral displacement. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
